content: 1) We present LaST-R1, a specialized RL post-training framework for “latent reasoning-before-acting” policies to enhance physical world modeling and robust action generation.
2) We propose Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization (LAPO), a novel RL algorithm that jointly optimizes latent reasoning and action generation via a unified step-level likelihood ratio.
3) We design an adaptive latent CoT mechanism that dynamically adjusts the reasoning horizon based on task diversity, balancing reasoning capacity and computational efficiency.
